name: 06070 · Simsbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06070 (Simsbury) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06070 (Simsbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06070 (Simsbury) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
